module: Proof of concept of a parser (PEG parser, via libs/lua-luaepnf/epnf) for TorqueScript files: 'new/singleton/datablock' declarations, properties, functions (body ignored). The file itself states 'not completely functional, far from ready'. Loaded with require('utils/torqueScriptParser').
usage:
local ts = require('utils/torqueScriptParser')
local ok, ast = ts.parse(readFile('/levels/xxx/main.cs'))
notes: The JIT is turned off (jit.off) while loading epnf because lulpeg would try to use VLA indexing, which is not supported.
parse directly returns the result of pcall: (true, ast) or (false, error message).
The body of TorqueScript functions is not parsed (balanced braces only).

parse.desc: Parses TorqueScript text with the internal grammar (epnf.parsestring) in a pcall.

returns.desc: Syntax tree on success, error message otherwise
